scheme_name: Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards
description:
The Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at promoting classical music and honoring the legacy of the renowned musician Pandit Omkarnath Thakur. 

The festival was launched in the year 2019. 

It is organized annually to celebrate the rich heritage of Indian classical music. 

The festival serves as a platform for both established and emerging artists to showcase their talents. 

It aims to foster appreciation for classical music among the younger generation. 

The festival is named after Pandit Omkarnath Thakur, who was a prominent figure in the field of Hindustani classical music. 

He was born on 30th April 1897 and passed away on 17th November 1967. 

His contributions to music include the popularization of various forms of classical music, particularly in the Gwalior gharana. 

The objectives of the festival include promoting classical music as an integral part of Indian culture. 

The festival aims to provide a platform for artists to perform and gain recognition. 

It seeks to encourage the youth to pursue careers in classical music. 

The festival also aims to create awareness about the importance of preserving traditional music forms. 

The event includes performances by renowned artists and competitions for budding musicians. 

The awards presented during the festival recognize outstanding contributions to classical music. 

The awards are given in various categories such as vocal music, instrumental music, and dance forms associated with classical music. 

The monetary value of the awards varies by category. 

For instance, winners may receive cash prizes ranging from INR 50,000 to INR 1,00,000. 

The festival also includes workshops and masterclasses conducted by eminent musicians. 

These workshops aim to provide training and guidance to aspiring artists. 

Eligibility to participate in the festival and awards is open to musicians of all ages. 

There are no specific age limits for participants. 

However, participants must demonstrate proficiency in classical music. 

The application process for the festival typically begins several months prior to the event. 

Interested artists must submit their applications online through the official festival website. 

The application usually requires details such as the artist's name, age, contact information, and a brief description of their musical background. 

Participants may also need to provide video recordings of their performances. 

The deadline for application submissions is usually set about two months before the festival. 

Selected participants are notified via email or phone. 

The festival is usually held in the month of November each year. 

The exact dates may vary from year to year. 

The festival spans over three to five days, depending on the schedule of events. 

Performances are held at various venues, often including auditoriums and open-air stages. 

The festival is organized by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India. 

The National School of Drama is often involved in the organization of the event. 

Contact details for inquiries can typically be found on the official website of the Ministry of Culture. 

The festival has gained recognition and popularity since its inception. 

It attracts a large audience, including music enthusiasts and students. 

The festival also garners media coverage, which helps in promoting the event. 

In the year 2022, the festival saw participation from over 200 artists across various categories. 

The festival has been instrumental in reviving interest in classical music among the youth. 

Feedback from participants indicates a positive impact on their careers. 

Many winners of the awards have gone on to achieve significant recognition in the music industry. 

The festival also collaborates with educational institutions to promote music education. 

Workshops conducted during the festival have seen participation from students of music colleges. 

The festival has also been supported by various sponsors and partners. 

These partnerships help in providing better facilities and opportunities for participants. 

The festival has also introduced a digital platform to reach a wider audience. 

This platform allows performances to be streamed online, increasing accessibility. 

The festival's impact can be measured by the growing number of participants each year. 

In 2023, the festival is expected to introduce new categories for awards. 

These may include awards for innovative compositions and fusion music. 

The festival emphasizes the importance of preserving traditional music while encouraging creativity. 

The awards are not only a recognition of talent but also a motivation for artists to continue their musical journey. 

The festival has become a significant event in the cultural calendar of India. 

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that the legacy of Pandit Omkarnath Thakur lives on. 

The festival is a testament to the Government of India's commitment to promoting arts and culture. 

It reflects the belief that music is a vital part of India's identity. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to ensure that classical music continues to thrive in the country. 

The festival is an important step towards nurturing the next generation of classical musicians. 

It highlights the need for continuous support and recognition of the arts in India. 

The Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards is a celebration of talent, culture, and heritage. 

It stands as a reminder of the rich musical traditions that India has to offer. 

The festival not only honors the past but also paves the way for future generations of musicians. 

It is an embodiment of the spirit of creativity and artistic expression that is inherent in Indian culture. 

The festival continues to inspire and uplift the classical music community in India.
